inventory.normalization: repository-relative POSIX paths in lexical order; Unicode NFC plus case-fold duplicate detection; SHA-256 over raw promoted bytes
inventory.digest: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON plus LF containing generated_paths, generated_files_sha256, and an empty symlink list

promotion_sanitization.excluded_transient_reason: upstream-packaged Python bytecode caches embed an upstream machine-local build path
promotion_sanitization.excluded_local_state_reason: installer-created personal answer and override files are not shared repository infrastructure
promotion_sanitization.root_ignore_follow_up: repository installation must add anchored /_bmad/config.user.toml while retaining nested custom *.user.toml

reproducibility.normalization: Only six manifest installDate/lastUpdated values, two generated config Date headers, and the three matching files-manifest hash cells are normalized; all other bytes remain strict

identifier_review.disposition: preserved as locked upstream BMAD template vocabulary; not references copied from this repository contract or execution plan

ci.normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys; job hashes exclude steps; step hashes include every step field
